raw_request: Complete Collab v2 role-free, tmux-only, low-intervention parity and formal migration under canonical AppSDK governance.
understood_objective: Rust exclusively owns peer, task, resource, wait, message, subscription, wake-attempt, journal, replay, and migration semantics; Node, Cordis, Codis, CLI, MCP, and transports remain typed adapters and projections.
acceptance_criteria: All identities are equal peers with owner-created task lifecycles and no role, dispatch, offer, claim, available queue, heartbeat, routine report, or ACK loop
Only RESOURCE_OCCUPIED and RESOURCE_RELEASED cross peers; tmux sends only COLLAB_NOTIFY plus message id after an exact finite subscription
Wait graph, three-attempt wake ledger, deterministic replay, and role-based v2 beta migration are Rust-owned and pass positive and negative tests
AppSDK verify, compile, freeze, isolated installed runtime blackbox, and AGY Review pass on one exact candidate
zterm, OneStop, RouteCodex, and dsh-plugins remain on verified v1 until explicit v2 production deployment
non_goals: Do not import v1 runtime truth
Do not add a second live notification channel
assumptions: Cordis remains the Node plugin lifecycle owner
Codis remains the process and container owner
